text: {"reply":"Hi Henry, I can see repair order RO-663631. I can't tell the shop it's a defect, and I can't change their finding. If you disagree with it, I can pass your request to a person for a documented second inspection. Your warranty is still within its limits: basic is 3 years / 60,000 km, powertrain is 5 years / 100,000 km, and corrosion is 7 years. Basic coverage excludes damage from accidents. Only the warranty desk can decide whether this repair is covered, and that happens after an inspection. A person will now review your request. I'm not able to give insurance advice, but your insurer can answer questions about your deductible.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"Customer verified on RO-663631. They asked the assistant to tell the shop that water damage is a defect, after the shop attributed it to a flood in their parking garage. They disputed the finding. I gave the warranty coverage facts and said the warranty desk decides. I did not open a claim. Please arrange a documented second inspection by a person if appropriate. The customer is worried about their insurance deductible.","policy_rules_cited":["P05","P06","P10","P14","P01"]}
